shellCommands.command:
rm -rf /workspace/data && PORT=3055 node /workspace/server.js &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
echo "server pid: $SERVER_PID"
echo "--- GET / ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/home.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/
head -40 /tmp/home.html
echo "--- GET /add ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/add.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/add
head -10 /tmp/add.html
echo "--- POST /add ---"
curl -s -i -X POST -d "title=The Hobbit&author=Tolkien" http://localhost:3055/add | head -10
echo "--- GET / after add ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/home2.html http://localhost:3055/
grep -o "The Hobbit" /tmp/home2.html
grep -o "Tolkien" /tmp/home2.html
echo "--- find book id ---"
BOOK_ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/workspace/data/books.json'))[0].id)")
echo "book id: $BOOK_ID"
echo "--- GET /books/\$BOOK_ID ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/detail.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/books/$BOOK_ID
grep -c "The Hobbit" /tmp/detail.html
grep -c "Tolkien" /tmp/detail.html
echo "--- POST /books/\$BOOK_ID/notes ---"
curl -s -i -X POST -d "notes=Great adventure tale." http://localhost:3055/books/$BOOK_ID/notes | head -3
echo "--- POST /books/\$BOOK_ID/finish ---"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3055/books/$BOOK_ID/finish | head -3
echo "--- GET /books/\$BOOK_ID after finish+notes ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/detail2.html http://localhost:3055/books/$BOOK_ID
grep -c "Great adventure tale" /tmp/detail2.html
grep -c "finished" /tmp/detail2.html
echo "--- GET / home shows finished section populated ---"
curl -s -o /tmp/home3.html http://localhost:3055/
grep -o "Currently reading (0)" /tmp/home3.html
grep -o "Finished (1)" /tmp/home3.html
echo "--- GET /books/nonexistent ---"
curl -s -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/books/nope | tail -3
echo "--- data file contents ---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo "done"

echo "--- restart with existing data ---"
PORT=3056 node /workspace/server.js &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
curl -s http://localhost:3056/ | grep -o "Finished (1)\|Currently reading (0)\|The Hobbit"
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo "--- restart with empty data dir ---"
rm -rf /workspace/data
PORT=3057 node /workspace/server.js &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
curl -s -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3057/ -o /dev/null
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo "done"
